column1: Note: This reports dispensation events, not prescribed quantity, a full stock movement ledger, returns, or reconciled charges.
Note: The item filter uses the recorded inventory-item ID only; unlinked historical events are not guessed.
Note: Missing historical item snapshots are left unknown; current inventory is not substituted.
Note: Dates are the recorded database calendar dates; these legacy timestamps do not record a timezone. Review historical timestamp origin before using them as local event dates.
Note: Missing or out-of-scope patient links are not inferred or matched by name and are counted for review.
Note: Data is a live snapshot and may change between pages or when regenerated.
